name: @mywebapi.com/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for CPlugin WebAPI: REST and WebSocket (SignalR) client that works with the MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 Manager API. Accounts, open positions, deposits, trade history, groups and symbols for brokers, from Node.js and browsers; OAuth2, retries, pagination and typed models included. MetaTrader is a trademark of MetaQuotes Ltd.; this project is not affiliated with MetaQuotes.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/node dist/browser && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/node --target node --format esm --external @microsoft/signalr && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/browser --target browser --format esm --external @microsoft/signalr && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration
